subtitulo: No fui a surfear porque llovía. Como llovía, no fui.
regla: Porque (because) goes after the main clause; como (since, as) starts the sentence, before the main clause; es que (it's just that, the thing is) introduces an explanation or an excuse, usually in conversation.

bloques.texto: Spanish has several ways to give a **cause**. At this level you need three, and the key is **where** each one goes.

filas: at the start, before the main clause

bloques.texto: **Como** with this meaning **never** goes after the main clause. If the cause comes second, use **porque**. To put the cause first, **como** is the natural choice; starting a statement with **porque** sounds heavy.
**Es que** is spoken and friendly. It softens an excuse or answers a complaint: _¿Por qué llegas tarde?_ — **Es que** había mucho tráfico.
You can also start with **porque** when you answer a question with **¿por qué?**: _¿Por qué no comes?_ — **Porque** no tengo hambre.
Spelling: **porque** (one word, no accent) = _because_. **¿Por qué?** (two words, accent) = _why?_
Tip: **como** opens the door, **porque** closes it, **es que** apologizes from the doorway.

lista.es: No fui a la playa ==porque== había mucho viento.
lista.en: I didn't go to the beach because it was very windy.

lista.es: ==Como== había mucho viento, no fui a la playa.
lista.en: Since it was very windy, I didn't go to the beach.

lista.es: Me quedé en casa ==porque== me dolía la rodilla.
lista.en: I stayed home because my knee hurt.

lista.es: ==Como== no tenía carro, me fui en el camión.
lista.en: Since I didn't have a car, I took the bus.

lista.es: ==Como== mañana es sábado, vamos a entrenar jiu-jitsu temprano.
lista.en: Since tomorrow is Saturday, we're going to train jiu-jitsu early.

lista.es: —¿Por qué no viniste? —==Es que== se me hizo tarde.
lista.en: "Why didn't you come?" "It's just that I was running late."

lista.es: Perdón, ==es que== no vi tu mensaje.
lista.en: Sorry, the thing is I didn't see your message.

lista.es: —¿Por qué riegas las plantas tan temprano? —==Porque== después hace mucho calor.
lista.en: "Why do you water the plants so early?" "Because it gets very hot later."

filas.t: No fui a la playa como llovía.
No fui a la playa porque llovía.
Cómo llovía, no fui a la playa.
Como llovía, no fui a la playa.
No comí por qué no tenía hambre.
No comí porque no tenía hambre.

lista.texto: Spelling and meaning: [[6333|porque vs por qué]].
Cause with a noun: [[5962|por for the cause or reason]].
A more formal cause: [[7086|debido a / debido a que]].
More options: [[7245|ya que, puesto que, no porque]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish, starting with the cause: _Since I was tired, I went to bed early._
lista.r: Como estaba cansado, me acosté temprano.

lista.p: Fix it: _No salí como hacía frío._
Make an excuse: _It's just that I didn't have time._
